summary: Iteration 10 targeted regression of the 5 iteration_9 fixes. Backend: 16 new pytest cases in test_iter10_fix_verification.py all pass (verify_domain idempotency incl. stable verified_at across 3 calls, 404 unknown/tampered, 400 expired seeded token, PUBLIC_APP_URL magic link, merged /onboarding/state shape after partial PATCH, school_name on /school/classes rows for tester + owner cross-school, roster CRUD + login/promo/DPA guardrails). Existing iter9 suite also re-run: 39/39 pass total. Frontend: /verify-domain with a fresh token shows verify-success on first load AND on reload (StrictMode double-invoke no longer burns the token), bogus token shows verify-error; owner /classes shows correct school-name tag on all sampled rows; Dashboard MagicLinkBanner copy button shows 'Verification link copied' toast and Dismiss works; tester /classes create + roster add still work.

minor.issue: PATCH response returns the raw stored onboarding doc (row.get('onboarding') or {}) instead of the merged default shape used by GET. Cosmetic inconsistency only - GET is correct; consider reusing the same merge for the PATCH response.

issues: School-name tag renders immediately after the class name with no leading space in the DOM text ('10A· TESTER DEMO ACADEMY'); visually fine but consider a space/separator margin for copy/paste and screen readers.

action_items: Optional: make PATCH /api/onboarding/state return the same merged {completed, step, dismissed} shape as GET.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_domain replay path correctly falls back to 400 when the token was consumed but the school has no domain_verified_at - good defensive behaviour.
GET /school/classes issues one extra schools query per request (batched via $in) - fine at current scale; add an index on schools.school_id if class counts grow.
